items.title: Labor-inflation prism: do not rely on a single unemployment/inflation aggregate

items.title: Chart patterns are risk/reward tools, not predictions

extraction.thesis: Patterns mostly do not predict; they define asymmetric reward/risk and invalidation.
extraction.automationHint: Render entry, invalidation, and reward/risk before pattern names.

items.title: AI infrastructure cycle: capex-lag illusion versus reinvestment trap; memory P versus neocloud Q-capital

extraction.thesis: Two hypotheses must stay live: AI capex may be a cash-flow timing lag before contracted cloud/TPU revenue, or it may be a structural trap where depreciation, recurring frontier-model reinvestment, and simultaneous hyperscaler capacity create a permanent capital treadmill.
extraction.paradigm: Memory is a P/ASP-and-multiple cycle; neocloud is a Q/utilization, rental-spread, depreciation, and capital-access cycle.
risks: capex growth remains above revenue growth
backlog does not convert before depreciation rises
compute/token prices fall faster than Q grows
narrow mega-cap stability masks weak breadth
oil and real yields reprice duration
extraction.automationHint: For every AI-infrastructure answer, separate memory P from neocloud Q-capital; compare the 2026-07-20 reference window with the latest time series; then list confirmation, invalidation, and missing evidence. Never use this item as a live quote or current fundamental block.

framework.Q2: Memory P/ASP/multiple versus neocloud Q/spread/capital is the decision-model change.
framework.Q3: Capex/revenue, backlog/depreciation, price/margin, utilization/spread, funding/credit, breadth/rates/oil are the key variables.
framework.Q4: Demand drives capacity spending; spending becomes depreciation and funding needs; falling compute prices compress spread; breadth and credit decide contagion.
framework.Q5: Power, cooling, optics, networking, storage, energy inflation, Korea/EWY, and index internals are adjacent spillovers.
chartReadingProtocol: Compare cap-weighted leadership with equal-weight, small-cap, sector, and cross-market participation.
Classify trend, moving-average slope, larger-timeframe location, support/resistance, channel, and confluence.
Prioritize reclaim or failed-retest acceptance over the first touch or a single candle.
Confirm with volume, breadth, relative strength, volatility, credit, and oscillator context; finish with invalidation and next observation window.

behaviorPlaybook.response: do not chase; preserve optionality and identify missing evidence

behaviorPlaybook.when: breadth, earnings/revisions, and price/volume reclaim provide at least two independent confirmations
behaviorPlaybook.response: treat as a staged hypothesis test; execution and sizing remain user-controlled

behaviorPlaybook.when: backlog/demand improves while depreciation, rental spread, funding, and credit remain contained
behaviorPlaybook.response: maintain the thesis conditionally and monitor the next checkpoint

behaviorPlaybook.when: breadth deterioration combines with VIX/HY OAS/real-yield/oil stress or funding/contract breaks
behaviorPlaybook.response: reduce leverage and reassess exposure against the mandate

communicationContract: separate observed, reference, and inferred evidence
close with confirmation, invalidation, horizon, and next check

items.title: AI 인프라 전력 품질·수요 반증·상대강도 눌림·클라이막스 탑·이벤트 캘린더

extraction.thesis: AI 인프라의 병목은 총 MWh뿐 아니라 GPU workload의 급격한 부하 변화와 전력품질이며, 수요 강세는 현금흐름·GPU 가격·프론티어 랩 성장·메모리 LTA·크레딧·전력 확보를 동시에 통과해야 한다.
extraction.powerQualityChain: GPU workload burst → load ramp/peak-to-average → transformer thermal stress, voltage/frequency fluctuation and harmonics → interconnection, onsite-power and adjacent-facility risk. Facility measurements are required.
demandFalsifiers: credit, lease funding or power delivery blocks capacity
setupFrame: two-way tape: continuation versus supply-side short research branch
TradingView winner evidence: price, ADR, 52-week-low distance, dollar liquidity and EMA8/21/60
record one-day gain/volume, 8/10-day run, railroad-track distribution and channel breakout
extraction.eventFrame: Economic and earnings calendars are catalysts/context only; event date, estimate, actual, surprise, liquidity and price/volume reaction must come from the live provider before a screen decision.
risks: GPU/DRAM/LTA claims from interview or X only
short inferred from weakness without supply/borrow evidence
calendar headline mistaken for earnings surprise or current signal
extraction.automationHint: Keep all extracted observations as REFERENCE. Use native live/snapshot/official evidence for current values; list confirmation, invalidation, missing fields, and next observation window. Never convert a setup label into an order.

framework.Q1: Is AI demand accelerating in measured utilization/cash flow, or only in narrative/capex?
framework.Q2: Is the stock a high-relative-strength pullback candidate, an overhead-supply short research branch, or an extended/climax-risk observation?
framework.Q3: Do power quality, GPU price, OCF, frontier-lab growth, memory LTA and credit evidence confirm the same direction?
framework.Q4: Does the catalyst produce accepted price/volume and breadth participation, or only a transient gap/rebound?
framework.Q5: What evidence invalidates the thesis: measured power-quality non-reproduction, demand falsifier, failed support/reclaim, or supply-side failure?

treat calendar/earnings events as catalysts until live actual/estimate evidence arrives
